name: Yaysuu's X-Treme Adventure
storyline: In the small Easthill island, YAYSUU and Teddy live a quiet life in their house, with their beloved cat. But this doesn't sit well with one, very mean inventor... None other than their arch nemesis, FRINGLEBERT THEODORE!! One day, YAYSUU wakes up to discover his cat has been stolen! Venturing outside into the Chill Fields, he comes across a squad of Fringlebots claiming the fields as their own, slowly killing the wildlife and plants... Now, it's up to YOU to stop Fringlebert and save the world! ... Oh, and the cat, too, obviously.
summary: Yaysuu's X-Treme Adventure is a side-scrolling 2D Platformer inspired by games like Sonic and Undertale. It stars the titular YAYSUU the Stickling, and his older brother Teddy, and the main villain, Fringlebert Theodore.
